title: Home Target Hits
description: Choose a safe wall target and see how many controlled hits you can make.
target: Hit the target 15 times from 30 attempts

title: Keep It Up
description: Use a balloon or light ball and try to keep it in the air with soft controlled touches.

title: Find the Space
description: Move around a safe area and stop in a new free space every time someone calls stop.
target: Complete 20 safe moves without touching another player or object

title: Quick Colour Reaction
description: Place four coloured markers around you and move to the colour called by a helper.

title: Support and Move
description: Pass to a partner or wall, then move quickly to a new receiving position.
